desc: 暖灰岩板硬侧光棚拍的蛋形罩盖奶瓶，十屏漏斗式留白详情
leaf: 蛋形磨砂瓶身宽口径透明罩盖奶瓶
name: 暖灰岩板酸黄方点奶瓶款

shots.intent: 用一整块暖灰岩板与硬侧光把蛋形磨砂瓶身、宽瓶盖环与透明罩盖一次交代清楚，抢首屏停留与点击
shots.textZone: 上部三分之一留白带放左对齐主标，主标直接压在一条通栏细下划线规则上，线端压一枚酸黄方点，其下一行小字副标

shots.intent: 把选购时的三条疑问做成下划线方点条目与三张空白填写板，条目全部占位以杜绝材质与功效杜撰
shots.textZone: 顶部一条小标题与通栏下划线方点，右侧三张空白板各接一条空白标签行，条目名全部占位

shots.intent: 复刻详情页两栏对照结构但左栏整块留白给卖家自贴，只拍本品瓶口闭合细节，绝不虚构对手品与胜负结论
shots.textZone: 顶部一条对照标题通栏下划线，两栏各一条空白标签行与一枚方点标

shots.intent: 仰视微距交代罩盖、瓶盖环与奶嘴的装配与闭合关系，用硬边投影撑起做工可信度
shots.textZone: 左下角一条空白标签行与一枚方点标

shots.intent: 以正侧面交代蛋形瓶身与圆弧底座的造型语言，三枚直角引线把结构条目全部交给占位符
shots.textZone: 左侧三行空白标签行，顶部一条造型小标题压通栏下划线，线端一枚酸黄方点

shots.intent: 放进硬光石质居家用语境让买家代入，成人从肩下取景、婴儿只留背影且全程被托抱看护
复刻六格工艺宫格的版式骨架但去掉全部图章图形与工艺名，六条空白行由占位符接管，杜绝参数与功效杜撰
shots.textZone: 六格各一条空白标签行，顶部一条宫格标题压通栏下划线方点

shots.intent: 复刻详情页产品档案双栏表结构，字段名与数值整块留空，从根上杜撰不出参数、材质与容量
shots.textZone: 下部两栏各三行空白填写位，字段名与数值全部占位

shots.intent: 同款两只瓶盖环双色并列撑起选款感，配色严格限定参考图已有的两档，选款标签整块留空
shots.textZone: 两瓶下方各一条空白标签行，顶部一条选款小标题压通栏下划线方点

shots.intent: 在同一石质体系里收口并留出行动位，把加购引导交给不编造事实的占位符，绝不出现价格与会员角标
shots.textZone: 下部留白带放结束标题、一枚空白行动按钮位与两条空白标签行，底部一条通栏下划线方点

style.backgroundSystem: matte stone and micro-cement slab surfaces only: one full-height warm limestone slab #D5D2CB backdrop sheet with a visible hard 90-degree arris and a fine mineral tooth, the product standing on one rectangular micro-cement tile #A8A49B with a crisp cut edge over a chalk #F1F0EC stone floor; flat layout screens are built on a chalk #F1F0EC paper field ruled with thin #A8A49B hairlines and edged by one narrow #E6FF3D accent band; every screen carries one hard-edged cast shadow and a visible stone joint line; never a limewash arched niche, never plaster steps or block tiers, never a glass sheet with a water line, never a fabric basket, linen or oak interior, never a circular podium disc or tangent sphere cluster, never a gradient card, never a dark or metallic field

style.iconSystem: thin underline rules with a small square tick only: every index and callout marker is one solid single-weight #A8A49B or #3C3A36 rule broken by one small filled #E6FF3D square of one single size, callouts drawn as one solid thin right-angle leader that starts on the referenced part with one small filled #E6FF3D square, turns once at 90 degrees and runs out to a completely empty label line; the six-cell grid carries a rule-and-tick marker above each blank line and no pictogram artwork at all; never a rounded-square squircle chip, never a dotted circle or dot ring, never a triangular pennant flag, never a filled circular stamp or knocked-out glyph chip, never a bare serif numeral, never a dashed square-chain leader, never a three-dot pagination marker, never a pill, medal, rosette, star or sun-burst glyph, never a second line weight

style.presentationRules: the bottle stands upright at a stable scale on the micro-cement tile with the clear dome overcap fitted, the wide collar ring screwed closed and the nipple fully seated inside the dome; the egg-shaped frosted body, the rounded base, the shoulder flare, the original dome height and the small apex nub on top of the overcap are never redrawn; the reference shows exactly two collar-ring colourways, one keyed #E7A69C and one keyed #A9C45F, and no third colourway may be invented; the inner seal ring visible at the neck keeps its reference placement and reads approximately #7A7286; the printed motif on the body front keeps its exact reference placement and scale while any wordmark or text inside the label area always reads as one blank legible field with no redrawn wording; any graduation or scale marking stays exactly as shot and is never added, removed or resized; the twin-loop grip-handle configuration appears only where the reference shows it and is never added to or removed from another screen; the product never floats without its contact shadow, is never occluded by props, keeps its crisp cast shadow, vertical lines stay vertical and one real object anchors scale in every scene shot
style.surfaceSystem: matte warm limestone slab #D5D2CB and micro-cement tile #A8A49B with fine unpolished mineral grain, a sharp sawn front edge and a hairline joint line between tiles; the frosted body settles on the tile with one true narrow contact shadow directly under the rounded base plus the long crisp cast shadow to camera left, no reflection, no wet floor and no soft feathered penumbra
style.typography: one modern medium-weight Chinese grotesque sans throughout, always flush left; a single short headline in ink #3C3A36 sitting directly on one thin full-width ink underline rule, the rule broken at its left end by one small solid acid-yellow #E6FF3D square tick, with one short sub-line in mid #A8A49B beneath the rule; section titles repeat the same underline-plus-tick device at a smaller size; one short line of copy only, no Latin overprint words, no wide-tracked kicker strips, no pill badges, no highlighter bands, no folded ribbon flags, no boxed headline frames, no dense body text, no mixed fonts
